description:
Very strong CSS3 and HTML5 skills. 
 • Solid Photoshop/GIMP and mockup/wireframing tooling skills. 
 • Experience with client side frameworks/libraries such as Bootstrap, JQuery, AngularJS, ReactJS and Knockout.js. 
 • Proficiency with REST API’s and JSON. & asynchronous request handling, partial page updates, and AJAX. 
 • Basic understanding of server-side CSS pre-processing platforms, such as LESS and SASS 
 • Excellent visual design skills with sensitivity to user-system interaction 
 • Ability to analyze problems and identify resolution strategically & functionally. 
 • Multitask and manage multiple medium to large projects in a cross-functional environment. 
 • Understanding of cross-browser compatibility issues 
 • Experience Using Material Design, Framework 7, Ionic. 
 • Experience using any AB testing tool or method (i.e. Adobe Test and target, Unbounce, VWO…) 
 • Use of Vector applications (Illustrator or Fireworks) 
 • Experience with Agile development methodology --SCRUM and KANBAN are considered a plus. 
 • Self-motivated, goal orientated quality driven, and capable of working independently with little supervision. 
 • Responsive Design (Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile) 
 • Ability to motivate, and mentor team members. 
 • Use of tools such as JIRA, Confluence, Splunk, and Microsoft Office 
 

 • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Advertising, Graphic Design or comparable job experience required. 
 • Minimum of six (6+) years of progressively related experience. 
 • Experience with packaged application delivery, such as SiteCore, SharePoint, Dynamics CRM, ERP or other business process application suites. 
 • Experience in initiating and implementing business process change. 
 

 Previousl experience in well-known global brand is considered ideal as well as a strong fundamental understanding of operational business processes, KPI’s and metrics.
 


 Ui/UX, CSS, Less, Javascript
